name: Stock Car Racing: Speedway Drive
summary:
Feel the intensity of high-speed VR stock car racing in **Stock Car Racing: Speedway Drive**. Fight for position in close-pack battles, use natural drafting to build speed, time your slingshot overtakes, and race from the cockpit across banked ovals, stadium speedways, a superspeedway, and a challenging roval.

# RACE ACROSS 5 MODES

- Quick Race — choose your car, track, field size, race length, and AI difficulty.
